title: How to Create a Drone Delivery Order
content: To create an order: (1) Select Origin Hub and Destination Hub; (2) Enter package details: weight (max 10kg) and package category; (3) Choose delivery mode: Normal, Express, or Scheduled; (4) Review the quotation and confirm. The order remains in PENDING status until an Operator schedules a flight mission.

title: Allowed Package Sizes
content: DroneOptAI supports 4 package sizes: Size S (≤1kg, ≤20x15x10cm), Size M (≤3kg, ≤35x25x20cm), Size L (≤5kg, ≤50x40x30cm), Size XL (≤10kg, ≤70x50x40cm). Packages exceeding maximum dimensions are not accepted. The maximum weight across the entire network is 10kg.

title: Accepted and Prohibited Package Categories
content: DroneOptAI accepts: Documents, Electronics, Clothing, Packaged food, Small household goods, Fragile items (+15% surcharge), and Non-hazardous medical supplies. NOT accepted: flammable liquids, weapons, toxic materials, loose lithium batteries, and live animals.

title: Delivery Shipping Fee Table
content: Fee = Base fee + Distance fee + Payload fee + Surcharges. Size S: Base 20,000 VND, 4,000 VND/km, 3,000 VND/kg. Size M: Base 30,000 VND, 5,000 VND/km, 4,000 VND/kg. Size L: Base 45,000 VND, 6,000 VND/km, 5,000 VND/kg. Size XL: Base 65,000 VND, 8,000 VND/km, 6,000 VND/kg. Surcharges: Express +25%, Fragile +15%, Insurance +10%.

title: Normal, Express, and Scheduled Delivery Modes
content: Normal (Standard): No need to pick a time slot; the system auto-schedules within a 4h SLA from booking. No surcharge. Customer drops off the package within 2h. Ideal when not urgent but same-day delivery is needed. Express: Priority delivery with +25% Core Fee surcharge; drones are prioritized for the earliest available schedule. Scheduled: Choose a specific delivery time with 0% surcharge; package must be handed over at least 3 hours before departure. Scheduled is recommended when timing is known in advance, and Normal when flexibility is preferred.

title: Order Tracking and Delivery Statuses
content: Order statuses: PENDING (awaiting processing), SCHEDULED (flight scheduled), IN_DELIVERY (drone in flight), ARRIVED_AT_HUB (arrived at destination hub, awaiting pickup), DELIVERED (completed). Customers can view real-time drone location, flight route, and ETA on the Tracking page.

title: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
content: ETA is calculated based on the flight route (Hub-to-Hub distance), drone speed (approx. 10-12 m/s), weather conditions, and fleet availability. ETA is displayed as an estimated time window (estimated_window_start and estimated_window_end) and may adjust according to live operational conditions.

title: Order Cancellation Policy
content: Customers can only cancel an order while it is in PENDING status (before a drone is assigned). Upon cancellation, the system sends a confirmation email. Orders already in SCHEDULED or IN_DELIVERY status cannot be cancelled directly. Contact an Operator for assistance in urgent cases.

title: Hub Pickup Procedure
content: After the drone lands at the Destination Hub, the package is held for up to 5 days. Customers receive reminder notifications every 5 hours. If uncollected after 5 days, the order is automatically cancelled. When picking up, present your order ID to the Technician at the Hub.

title: Package Insurance
content: DroneOptAI offers optional package insurance for +10% of the Core Fee. Insurance covers damage caused by drone technical failures. It does not cover damage due to improper packaging or prohibited items. Select 'has_insurance=true' when creating an order.
